findings.finding: Unbounded os.listdir allocation before inventory rejection.
findings.resolution: Resolved: scandir refuses upon obtaining the fourth entry, with exact-three-name comparison and a regression proving no fifth entry is requested.

findings.finding: Read-opening a candidate special file before type validation.
findings.resolution: Resolved: non-following stat plus O_PATH pin and full stamp equality precede read-only trusted-procfd reopen of the validated regular inode. Regression replaces a name with FIFO between stat and pin and checks no non-regular read-open occurs. No runtime fallback on unsupported platforms.

findings.finding: Design overstated cleanup as guaranteeing no descriptor survives any failing call.
findings.resolution: Resolved: design distinguishes successful complete cleanup from attempts on failure and expressly disclaims recovery from every possible OS close failure.
